verdict.rationale: Munito AI documents drop-in compatibility with the official OpenAI and Anthropic SDKs: you change the base URL, key and model ID. It supports the Chat Completions, Responses, speech-to-text and Messages APIs, provides Python, TypeScript and cURL quickstarts, and a probe confirmed a published OpenAPI spec. It also lists LangChain and LlamaIndex integrations. However, there is no evidence of a first-party Munito SDK, so building against SDKs relies on other vendors' clients through API compatibility. Missing for 10: a first-party official Munito SDK (e.g., Python/TypeScript packages), and independent or hands-on confirmation that the OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs work fully against the endpoints.
